Messages.Author: Joscha
Messages.Body:
We had a starter + 4 boosters-Draft two weeks ago. Robert Fängler tried the Anathemastarter with mediocre success. But he played a Rebirth with Jayne Jonestown after diablerizing Francis Milliner of his Predator. Never saw that card in action before.

Draft = fun!

Rebirth, Action Modifier, Red List, R , [KMW]
Requires a Red List minion. Only usable when a diablerie action is successful. No blood hunt may be called, and this vampire untaps. A vampire can play only one Rebirth each turn.

Baron of Frankfurt

Messages.Author: ReverendRevolver
Messages.Body:
My favorite draft moment is when i played third edition claws of the dead draft text with blaise. Ha! I can agg poke like the rest of this crypt!
Ive only seen rebirth used maybe once, in casual play, and i think the player scrapped that deck quickly.

Draft combos are always interesting thiugh, ive seen enky with bravo, which was rediculous mid game when blood was low and gaining it while punching for 3 was just like cheating, especially with fortitude. I also saw someone eraft a kindred spirits deck that was 12 ks with dolphin and co and the 3rd exition crowd. It was a few cards away from better than many constructed decks...
